messages:
ravi: heads-up — seeing a ~3% invoice delta for yesterday's EU window after the 03:10 failover. digging but wanted to flag.
sasha: ugh. is that tokens or reqs? where's the delta surface?
ravi: tokens. invoice lines show ~1.2M tokens missing vs live usage. cross-checking metering ingest and invoice assembly now.
billing-bot: automated-detect: anomalies >1% between ingest and invoice totals for tenant set 'parkway-pp', window 2024-11-02T03:00-04:00Z :eyes:
maya: did the routing fallback add any new headers or change fingerprinting? last rollout added X-RouteHint in proxy.
ravi: logs show routing proxy swapped route id and we see two different client_fingerprint values for same session_id after fallback.
jordan: can you paste the sample event? small snippet is fine.
ravi: sure:
```
{ "session_id": "S-9a3f", "client_fingerprint": "fp_v2_abc123", "route": "eu-fallback", "tokens": 348 }
{ "session_id": "S-9a3f", "client_fingerprint": "fp_old_xyz789", "route": "eu1", "tokens": 204 }
```
maya: that matches my suspicion — when proxy rewrites X-RouteHint we also regenerate fingerprint in the agent. so dedupe key changed.
ops-ian: replaying raw events into invoice assembler naively will double-charge. we need idempotency at ingestion or reconciliation that stitches by session_id.
sasha: console/alerts ask: could we surface a per-route 'fallback-routed' column in the usage dashboard, plus an alert when route-based dedupe mismatch >0.5%? product wants early visibility.
ryan: plan suggestion: add canonical_client_fingerprint to the post-routing event, keep current fingerprint for debugging, and add a reconciliation job that coalesces events by session_id+canonical_client_fingerprint for 72 hrs. shadow roll for 24 hrs first.
maya: that requires a small proxy change (one header), an ingestion schema bump, and a toggle in the console feature flags. can do the proxy patch today.
ravi: I'll open issue + include the aggregation query. quick SQL I used:
```
SELECT session_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(distinct client_fingerprint) as fp_count
FROM metering.events
WHERE ts >= '2024-11-02' AND route LIKE 'eu%'
GROUP BY session_id
HAVING fp_count > 1
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
sasha: nice. UX asks for an ephemeral 'reconcile' button in billing UI to run a locked, non-chargeable reconcile preview so finance can see before applying. 
ops-ian: can we mark reconcile runs as preview/non-apply in the ledger? e.g., invoice_dry_run flag so downstream charges don't mutate tenant balances.
jordan: +1. also add telemetry tags for 'reconcile.preview' vs 'reconcile.apply' so we can trace what was run.
billing-bot: note: if reconcile.apply is run we will emit invoice_event.* with invoice_reconciled=true — ensure alerting on that to ops.
ryan: I'll do the proxy + ingestion schema PR, shadow-ingest to kafka->metering-shadow for 24h, then open a canary rollout to 10% tenants.
maya: ping me for the proxy review. I'll also add the console flag and the dashboard tile (fallback-routed counts + token skew pct).
ravi: created issue #4521 (link: https://redwood.company/issue/4521) with todos: proxy header, ingestion schema bump, reconcile job, console flag, billing dry-run UX. I'll coordinate patch rollout and postmortem if needed. thanks all :thumbsup:
sasha: thanks — please tag finance when you run the preview. keeping this thread for traceability.
